- `body`: GitHub-flavored markdown in 1–3 short sentences explaining the issue, its impact, and what to change. Reference symbols and file names in backticks. Do not include title/severity headings.

Use `granularity: "range"` with `end_line` only when the full finding genuinely spans multiple changed right-side lines. Prefer a single changed line.

diff --git a/cmd/entire/cli/agent/testing.go b/cmd/entire/cli/agent/testing.go
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..26ce9540
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cmd/entire/cli/agent/testing.go
@@ -0,0 +1,33 @@
+package agent
+
+import (
+	"maps"
+
+	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/types"
+)
+
+// SnapshotForTesting captures the registry's current contents and returns a
+// function that restores it to exactly that state.
+//
+// Tests that trigger agent registration as a side effect — external-agent
+// discovery via runAgentList, for example — must defer or t.Cleanup the
+// returned restore. Otherwise mock agents backed by t.TempDir binaries leak
+// into the process-global registry and corrupt later tests in the package:
+// GetAgentsWithHooksInstalled would exec their now-deleted binaries, and only
+// TempDir cleanup ordering keeps that from mis-reporting installed agents.
+//
+// Capture and restore both hold registryMu, so readers never observe a
+// half-updated registry. Concurrent *writers* are not accounted for: restore
+// replaces the whole map, so any Register that lands between capture and
+// restore is discarded. Callers are serial tests, where that cannot happen.
+func SnapshotForTesting() func() {
+	registryMu.Lock()
+	defer registryMu.Unlock()
+	snapshot := make(map[types.AgentName]Factory, len(registry))
+	maps.Copy(snapshot, registry)
+	return func() {
+		registryMu.Lock()
+		defer registryMu.Unlock()
+		registry = snapshot
+	}
+}

15	var (
16		registryMu sync.RWMutex
17		registry   = make(map[types.AgentName]Factory)
18	)
19	
20	// Factory creates a new agent instance
21	type Factory func() Agent
22	
23	// Register adds an agent factory to the registry.
24	// Called from init() in each agent implementation.
25	func Register(name types.AgentName, factory Factory) {
26		registryMu.Lock()
27		defer registryMu.Unlock()
28		registry[name] = factory
29	}
30	
31	// Get retrieves an agent by name.
32	//
33	
34	func Get(name types.AgentName) (Agent, error) {
35		registryMu.RLock()
36		defer registryMu.RUnlock()
37	
38		factory, ok := registry[name]
39		if !ok {
40			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown agent: %s (available: %v)", name, ListAll())
41		}
42		return factory(), nil
43	}
44	
45	// ListAll returns every registered agent name in sorted order, test-only
46	// agents included.
47	//
48	// Use it to act on or report the state of what is actually registered:
49	// installing and uninstalling hooks, detecting which agent owns a transcript,
50	// listing agents whose hooks are installed. The Vogon canary must appear
51	// there — e2e installs its hooks, and omitting it would misreport the repo.
52	//
53	// Anything that offers the user a choice of agent wants ListAvailable or
54	// AvailableNames instead; no picker, prompt, or "available agents" listing
55	// should advertise a test-only agent.
56	func ListAll() []types.AgentName {
57		registryMu.RLock()
58		defer registryMu.RUnlock()
59	
60		names := make([]types.AgentName, 0, len(registry))
61		for name := range registry {
62			names = append(names, name)
63		}
64		slices.Sort(names)
65		return names
66	}
67	
68	// ResolvedAgent pairs an agent with the registry name it is addressed by.
69	// The registry name — not Agent.Name() — is the identity users type and
70	// Get accepts; an external plugin's self-reported name can differ from the
71	// name derived from its binary, which is what it is registered under.
72	type ResolvedAgent struct {
73		Name  types.AgentName
74		Agent Agent
75	}
76	
77	// ListAvailable returns the resolved agents a user may pick, in sorted name
78	// order: every registered agent except the test-only ones. It is the single
79	// place the test-only filter is applied, so callers that need the Agent value
80	// (to check hook support or externality) get the same answer as callers that
81	// only need names via AvailableNames.
82	//
83	// Agents that vanish from the registry between listing and resolving (a
84	// concurrent restore of a testing snapshot is the only way that happens) are
85	// skipped.
86	func ListAvailable() []ResolvedAgent {
87		names := ListAll()
88		agents := make([]ResolvedAgent, 0, len(names))
89		for _, name := range names {
90			ag, err := Get(name)
91			if err != nil {
92				continue
93			}
94			if to, ok := ag.(TestOnly); ok && to.IsTestOnly() {
95				continue
96			}
97			agents = append(agents, ResolvedAgent{Name: name, Agent: ag})
98		}
99		return agents
100	}
101	
102	// AvailableNames returns the names of ListAvailable, for display.
103	func AvailableNames() []string {
104		resolved := ListAvailable()
105		names := make([]string, 0, len(resolved))
106		for _, ra := range resolved {
107			names = append(names, string(ra.Name))
108		}
109		return names
110	}

112	// DetectAll returns all agents whose DetectPresence reports true.
113	// Agents are checked in sorted name order (via ListAll()) for deterministic results.
114	// Returns an empty slice when no agent is detected.
115	func DetectAll(ctx context.Context) []Agent {
116		names := ListAll() // sorted, lock-safe
117	
118		var detected []Agent
119		for _, name := range names {
120			ag, err := Get(name)
121			if err != nil {
122				continue
123			}
124			if present, err := ag.DetectPresence(ctx); err == nil && present {
125				detected = append(detected, ag)
126			}
127		}
128		return detected
129	}

131	// AgentForTranscriptPath returns the registered agent whose session directory
132	// for repoPath contains the given transcript path. Used to disambiguate which
133	// agent owns a session when multiple agents' hooks fire for the same session
134	// ID — a Cursor transcript path uniquely identifies a Cursor session even
135	// when Claude Code's hook is the one firing.
136	//
137	// Returns (nil, false) if transcriptPath is empty, no agent claims it, or any
138	// registry lookup fails. Match is by directory prefix (with a separator) so
139	// "/x/.claude/projects/abc.jsonl" doesn't accidentally match an agent rooted
140	// at "/x/.claude/projects/ab".
141	//
142	//nolint:revive // AgentForTranscriptPath: stutter is intentional for package callers (agent.AgentForTranscriptPath reads naturally)
143	func AgentForTranscriptPath(transcriptPath, repoPath string) (Agent, bool) {
144		if transcriptPath == "" {
145			return nil, false
146		}
147		abs, err := filepath.Abs(transcriptPath)
148		if err != nil {
149			abs = transcriptPath
150		}
151		for _, name := range ListAll() {
152			ag, err := Get(name)
153			if err != nil {
154				continue
155			}
156			dir, err := ag.GetSessionDir(repoPath)
157			if err != nil || dir == "" {
158				continue
159			}
160			dirAbs, err := filepath.Abs(dir)
161			if err != nil {
162				dirAbs = dir
163			}
164			if pathHasDirPrefix(abs, dirAbs) {
165				return ag, true
166			}
167		}
168		return nil, false
169	}
170	
171	// pathHasDirPrefix reports whether path is contained within dir (or equals it).
172	// Adds a trailing separator before prefix-matching so /a/bc doesn't match /a/b.
173	//
174	// On Windows, comparison is case-insensitive: NTFS/ReFS treat paths as
175	// case-insensitive, and filepath.Abs preserves whatever casing the input had,
176	// so a transcript path like `C:\Users\Bob\.cursor\...` and a session dir like
177	// `c:\users\bob\.cursor\...` refer to the same location but would not match
178	// under a byte-wise comparison.
179	func pathHasDirPrefix(path, dir string) bool {
180		if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
181			path = strings.ToLower(path)
182			dir = strings.ToLower(dir)
183		}
184		if path == dir {
185			return true
186		}
187		if !strings.HasSuffix(dir, string(filepath.Separator)) {
188			dir += string(filepath.Separator)
189		}
190		return strings.HasPrefix(path, dir)
191	}

231	func GetByAgentType(agentType types.AgentType) (Agent, error) {
232		registryMu.RLock()
233		defer registryMu.RUnlock()

235		for _, factory := range registry {

242		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown agent type: %s", agentType)

245	// AllProtectedDirs returns the union of ProtectedDirs from all registered agents.
246	func AllProtectedDirs() []string {
247		// Copy factories under the lock, then release before calling external code.
248		registryMu.RLock()
249		factories := make([]Factory, 0, len(registry))
250		for _, f := range registry {
251			factories = append(factories, f)
252		}
253		registryMu.RUnlock()
254	
255		seen := make(map[string]struct{})
256		var dirs []string
257		for _, factory := range factories {
258			for _, d := range factory().ProtectedDirs() {
259				if _, ok := seen[d]; !ok {
260					seen[d] = struct{}{}
261					dirs = append(dirs, d)
262				}
263			}
264		}
265		slices.Sort(dirs)
266		return dirs
